tools.name: get_business_profile
tools.description: Read the business identity, public contact details, and Greater Houston service area.

tools.name: search_appraisal_services
tools.description: Find residential appraisal services by matching a short, general question to published service names and descriptions. Do not include a property address, phone number, or email address.

tools.name: get_blank_message_template
tools.description: Return a blank SMS or email template with placeholders for the details Alex needs. This tool accepts no personal or property details and does not send, submit, or store a message.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_appraisal_services, get_blank_message_template · Private data: get_business_profile · Public sink: search_appraisal_services, get_blank_message_template.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_appraisal_services, get_blank_message_template · Private data: get_business_profile · Public sink: search_appraisal_services, get_blank_message_template

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
